scene iosawsomethingtoo1
: Is something wrong, Yasu? It’s not like you to just wander into a conversation two people are having and just- actually, no. That is exactly like you.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Yasu？你居然会随随便便闯进别人的对话里插一嘴——算了，不对。这确实就是你会干的事。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t make it any less concerning.
lines.zh: : 但这并不代表它就不让人担心。

lines.en: : What should be concerning to everyone is the alluring fragrance of a nearby angel and the wonderful luck it will bring to all of us.
lines.zh: : 大家真正该在意的是，附近有一位天使身上那诱人的香气，以及它将为我们所有人带来的好运。

lines.en: : Umm...
: Don’t get me wrong, I do think Sana smells nice. But I’m not really sure if I’d call it good luck.
lines.zh: : 别误会，我确实觉得 Sana 闻起来很好闻。但我不太确定这能不能叫好运。

lines.en: : The angel part is spot on, though. Isn't she great?
lines.zh: : 不过天使那部分说得很准。她很棒，不是吗？

lines.en: : It is not her that smells like heaven. The scent comes from the thoughts she thinks and the things that she will see behind closed doors.
lines.zh: : 有天堂般气味的并不是她。那气味来自她心里的念头，来自她即将在紧闭的门后看到的景象。

lines.en: : Yasu...you’re scaring me...
lines.zh: : Yasu……你吓到我了……

lines.en: : How do you hold it all in? Does it not eat away at you? Does it not make you sweat?
lines.zh: : 你是怎么把这些全都憋在心里的？它不会一点点把你啃食掉吗？不会让你冒汗吗？

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo2
: A...Ayane? Can you...maybe do something?...
lines.zh: : A……Ayane？你能不能……想想办法？……

lines.en: : I’m not really sure what I can do. I’ve tried Touka’s “boop” tactic on Yasu seven times and it’s had no effect. I’m pretty sure the only one who can actually influence her behavior is Touka.
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定我能做什么。Touka 那套"啵"的战术我已经对 Yasu 试过七次了，一点用都没有。我敢说真正能影响她行为的人只有 Touka。

lines.en: : That is simply not true. All of my actions are predetermined by God Almighty and the only one who can puppet this fragile body of mine is Him.
lines.zh: : 那完全不是事实。我的一切行为都由全能的神预先决定，唯一能操纵我这副脆弱躯壳的只有祂。

lines.en: : But I am not the sole vessel here being puppeted. Isn’t that right, Sana?
lines.zh: : 但这里被操纵的容器并不只有我一个。对吧，Sana？

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo3
: I...really don’t...have any idea what...you’re talking about...
lines.zh: : 我……真的完全……不知道你在……说什么……

lines.en: : Then why is the sound of your heartbeat resonating throughout my blessed ears? Why does the blood pool in your face?
lines.zh: : 那你心跳的声音为何在我这双蒙福的耳朵里回响？为什么血都涌到你脸上去了？

lines.en: : You know these answers, yet conceal them as you’re afraid of the way you feel.
lines.zh: : 你明明知道这些答案，却因为害怕自己的感受而把它们藏起来。

lines.en: : Indulge. You are free unlike me. You can let them in.
lines.zh: : 放纵吧。你和我不同，你是自由的。你可以放它们进来。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo4
: L...Let who in?! I don’t understand!
lines.zh: : 放……放谁进来？！我不明白！

lines.en: : The ones who make you feel this way in the first place.
lines.zh: : 就是一开始让你产生这种感觉的那些人。

lines.en: : Feel what way?! I feel...t-t-t-totally normal! There are no...angels or...weird feelings here!
lines.zh: : 什么感觉？！我觉得……我我我……完全正常！这里没有什么……天使，也没有什么……奇怪的感觉！

lines.en: : Liar.
lines.zh: : 骗子。

lines.en: : Liar.
lines.zh: : 骗子。

lines.en: : Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar. Liar.
lines.zh: : 骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。骗子。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo5
: Ayane! Help!
lines.zh: : Ayane！救命！

lines.en: : Yasu, maybe it would be best if you ran along and looked for Touka? I think Sana would rather be alone right now.
lines.zh: : Yasu，你要不要赶紧去找 Touka 比较好？我觉得 Sana 现在更想一个人待着。

lines.en: : Yes. I also think Sana should be alone right now. For it is only in the deepest bouts of loneliness that we unmask ourselves. And I can feel her desire to tear that mask off dripping from her tiny body.
lines.zh: : 是的。我也觉得 Sana 现在应该一个人待着。因为只有在最深的孤独里，我们才会摘下自己的面具。而我能感觉到，她想撕掉那张面具的渴望，正从她小小的身体上滴落下来。

lines.en: : D-Desire doesn’t...drip! It doesn’t do anything! It’s...invisible!
lines.zh: : 渴……渴望是不会……滴下来的！它什么都不会做！它是……看不见的！

lines.en: : Maybe to everyone else. But to some of us, it’s fully tangible.
lines.zh: : 也许对别人来说是这样。但对我们中的某些人来说，它完全摸得着。

lines.en: : And if it was not a sin to do so, I could reach out...and curl my tiny fingers around your desires right now.
lines.zh: : 倘若这么做不是罪过，我现在就可以伸出手……用我小小的手指，把你的欲望攥住。

lines.en: : Why are you still here?
lines.zh: : 你怎么还在这？

lines.en: : Because I’m scared and I can’t move!
lines.zh: : 因为我害怕，动不了！

lines.en: : Yasu...take a hint, please...
lines.zh: : Yasu……拜托你识趣一点……

lines.en: : Do it.
lines.zh: : 动手吧。

lines.en: : God wants to watch.
lines.zh: : 神想要看。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo6
: O...On second thought...I’m...umm...isn’t it...really hot out today?!
lines.zh: : 那……那个，我再想想……我……嗯……今天外面是不是特别热啊？！

lines.en: : M...Maybe it would...be best if I...went and took a break somewhere?...Like...somewhere...far away from Yasu...
lines.zh: : 也……也许我最好……去别的地方休息一下？……比如……离 Yasu 远远的地方……

lines.en: : Hehehehehhhehehhhheheh~
lines.zh: : Hehehehehhhehehhhheheh~

lines.en: : Drip. Drip. Drip.
lines.zh: : 滴答。滴答。滴答。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo7
: Okay! Bye!
lines.zh: : 好的！再见！

lines.en: : Now...I’m only nineteen more good deeds away from earning my daily angel point.
lines.zh: : 现在……只要再做十九件善事，我就能拿到今天的天使点数了。

lines.en: : Enjoy the show, Father. I hope it’s as nostalgic as you want it to be.
lines.zh: : 好好欣赏这场戏吧，父啊。希望它能像你所期望的那样令人怀念。

lines.en: : Are you happy now, Yasu? You scared her away.
lines.zh: : 这下你满意了吧，Yasu？你把人家吓跑了。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo8
: Hm? Scared who away?
lines.zh: : 嗯？把谁吓跑了？

lines.en: : Where is Touka? And why do my legs feel all wobbly?
lines.zh: : Touka 在哪儿？还有我的腿为什么软绵绵的？

lines.en: : You know what...forget it. I hope your angel point was worth it.
lines.zh: : 算了……当我没说。希望你那点天使点数值得。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll excuse me, I should go find the girl you just traumatized and-
lines.zh: : 现在，失陪一下，我得去找那个刚被你吓出心理阴影的女孩，然后——

lines.en: : No. We should stay here and talk instead. Tragedy is sure to come if we do not.
lines.zh: : 不。我们应该留在这里聊聊。不这么做的话，悲剧一定会降临。

lines.en: : Tragedy?
lines.zh: : 悲剧？

lines.en: : We will all be sent back if He remains unsatisfied.
lines.zh: : 如果祂依旧不满意，我们都会被送回去。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo9
: Sent...back how?...
lines.zh: : 怎么……送回去？……

lines.en: : That’s a good question...I don’t really know...
lines.zh: : 问得好……我也不是很清楚……

lines.en: : I am better at listening than interpreting. It sometimes makes me do things the wrong way. It forces me to utter the incorrect words.
lines.zh: : 我擅长倾听，却不擅长解读。这有时会让我用错误的方式做事，逼我说出不对的话。

lines.en: : But I’m being told that you should already know the answer to that.
lines.zh: : 但我听到的是，你早就该知道那个答案了。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo10
: Told by...who?...
lines.zh: : 谁……告诉你的？……

lines.en: : Yasu?...
lines.zh: : Yasu？……

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo11
: You can meet Him if you want.
lines.zh: : 你愿意的话，可以去见祂。

lines.en: : He’s not very far.
lines.zh: : 祂并不远。

lines.en: : All you have to do is follow the lights.
lines.zh: : 你只要跟着那些光走就行。

lines.en: : Can you see them?
lines.zh: : 你能看见吗？

lines.en: : There are four. But only one is bright enough to be seen in the dark.
lines.zh: : 一共有四束。但只有一束亮到能在黑暗中被看见。

lines.en: : I...probably shouldn’t be going out of my way to meet strangers or...gods I’m not really familiar with.
lines.zh: : 我……大概不该特意跑去见陌生人，或者……我并不熟悉的神。

lines.en: : Not even if it can bring you one step closer to what it is you want?
lines.zh: : 哪怕它能让你离自己想要的东西更近一步，也不去吗？

lines.en: : And...And what is it I want exactly?
lines.zh: : 那……那我想要的到底是什么？

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo12
: To take her place.
lines.zh: : 取代她的位置。

lines.en: : No, that’s not what I-
lines.zh: : 不，我才没有——

lines.en: : Blink and you will see Him.
lines.zh: : 一眨眼，你就能见到祂。

scene iosawsomethingtoo13
: Sensei! Heya! Whatcha doing all by your lonesome?
lines.zh: : 老师！嗨！你一个人在这儿干嘛呢？

lines.en: : Nothing really. I thought it was Ami time, but she kind of just vanished and I have no idea where she went.
lines.zh: : 也没什么。我以为到了 Ami 时间，结果她就这么凭空消失了，我完全不知道她去哪了。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo14
: What’s Ami time? Is that what it’s called when she grinds out love points and stretches that number one harem lead of hers into an even bigger lead?
lines.zh: : 什么叫 Ami 时间？就是她疯狂刷好感度、把她那个后宫第一名的领先优势拉得更大时，你们是这么叫的？

lines.en: : Why is Ami still in first place? There has to be someone I’m not related to that would make a better more socially acceptable candidate for that.
lines.zh: : 为什么 Ami 还排在第一？总该有哪个跟我没有血缘关系的人，更适合、也更说得过去吧。

lines.en: : Beats me, but it sounds like she’s the only one who’s got a dedicated time named after her. Can’t remember the last instance of “Uta time.”
lines.zh: : 我哪知道，不过听起来她是唯一一个拥有专属时段的人。我已经想不起来上一次"Uta 时间"是什么时候了。

lines.en: : I will gladly spend the rest of my life in Uta time. You’re the only one preventing that from happening.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意把余生都耗在 Uta 时间里。唯一阻止这件事发生的就是你。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo15
: Oh, stop...you’d get bored of me sooner than ya think...then it would be right back to the drawing board.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别说了……你会比你以为的更快对我厌烦……然后又得从头再来。

lines.en: : Plus, long distance calls can get pretty expensive this time of year and there’d just be way too many calls I’d need to make if we really did do something like that.
lines.zh: : 再说，这个时节长途电话费可不便宜，如果我们真要那么做，我得打的电话也太多了。

lines.en: : If I need to pay one more phone bill to get into your pants, I will gladly do it.
lines.zh: : 只要能爬上你的床，再付一次电话费我也心甘情愿。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo16
: Hahah...hah...and yet you returned my underwear...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……可你还是把我的内衣还回来了……

lines.en: : Did you...want me to keep them?
lines.zh: : 你……想让我留着吗？

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo17
: Wha- obviously not! I just figured that the real move if you were so dead set on perving out on me would be to keep them to yourself and never tell me about it!
lines.zh: : 什——当然不是！我只是觉得，如果你非要对我耍流氓，正确的做法应该是自己偷偷留着，然后永远别告诉我！

lines.en: : Getting something like that back from a guy is kind of insulting, you know!
lines.zh: : 从一个男人手里拿回这种东西，其实挺伤人的，你知道吗！

lines.en: : Sorry. I didn’t realize how experienced you were when it came to lending out underwear.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不知道你在"外借内衣"这件事上经验这么丰富。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo18
: That, uhh...
lines.zh: : 这个，呃……

lines.en: : It kinda stings a little when you put it that way, you know?...
lines.zh: : 被你这么一说，还挺刺人的，你知道吗？……

lines.en: : I didn’t mean anything by it, Uta.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思，Uta。

lines.en: Nor did I acknowledge the possibility that my throwaway joke would have been an actual possibility for her, but...I guess there’s still a lot I don’t know about her past.
lines.zh: 我也没想过自己随口开的玩笑对她来说也许真的发生过，但……看来她的过去还有很多我不知道的事。

lines.en: And a lot I’m in no rush to find out.
lines.zh: 也有很多我并不急着去弄清楚的事。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo19
: Yeah! I...I know! I guess I’m just still kind of embarrassed about the whole...you carrying my underwear home with you and...and then washing them and then...bringing them back to my dorm...thing.
lines.zh: : 是啦！我……我知道！我只是还是有点不好意思，就是……你把我的内裤带回家，然后……然后洗了，再然后……送回我宿舍……那件事。

lines.en: Not washing them wasn’t really an option after the mileage I got out of them.
lines.zh: 在把它们用到那种程度之后，不洗实在说不过去。

lines.en: : But uhh...back to things that...don’t make me feel all horrible inside...Christmas! Right?!
lines.zh: : 不过呃……还是回到那些……不会让我心里难受的话题吧……圣诞节！对吧？！

lines.en: : Right...Christmas.
lines.zh: : 对……圣诞节。

lines.en: I do my best to throw Uta a life raft and abandon further embarrassing her even when I know that continuing to press her on the matter could land her in my arms by the end of the night.
lines.zh: 我尽力给 Uta 扔个救生圈，不再继续让她难堪——哪怕我心里清楚，继续在这件事上逼她，今晚结束前她可能就会落进我怀里。

lines.en: Because, as enticing as it is to contemplate the idea of a fun-sized, yet surprisingly well-endowed, maid bouncing up and down on my dick in the ekiben position, I have grown past that.
lines.zh: 因为，尽管想象一个娇小却意外有料的女仆以"駅弁"的姿势在我身上上下起伏确实很诱人，但我已经过了那个阶段了。

lines.en: And I now find myself, more often than not, thinking about how the recipient of my manhood will feel for a second or two before ultimately abandoning that idea altogether and continuing to press them anyway.
lines.zh: 而现在的我，越来越常花上一两秒去想，承受我那话儿的人会是什么感受——然后最终把这个念头彻底抛开，继续逼她们。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo20
: Are you, like...excited for the party and stuff?
lines.zh: : 你……那个，期待派对之类的吗？

lines.en: BEFORE CONTINUING TO PRESS THEM ANYWAY
lines.zh: ——然后照旧继续逼她们。

lines.en: Ugh...
I miss the me who didn’t actually care about these girls.
lines.zh: 我怀念那个对这些女孩根本不上心的自己。

lines.en: : As excited as I can be, I guess. Christmas isn’t really my kind of holiday.
lines.zh: : 也就那样吧，我猜。圣诞节不太是我的菜。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo21
: What is your kind of holiday, then? You seemed pretty energetic during Halloween. Is that it?
lines.zh: : 那你喜欢哪个节日？万圣节那会儿你看起来挺来劲的。是那个吗？

lines.en: : Probably. Crazy to believe that was nearly two months ago, right?
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。真难相信那都快两个月前了，对吧？

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo22
: You think so? Seems about right to me. But all things considered, I guess stuff has been kinda anticlimactic since then.
lines.zh: : 你这么觉得？我觉得差不多。不过总的来说，从那之后一切都挺虎头蛇尾的。

lines.en: : Feel like you haven’t even really come to the maid cafe at all either. Somethin’ going on at home that you wanna talk about? Does it have to do with Ami time?
lines.zh: : 感觉你也没怎么来女仆咖啡厅了。家里出了什么事想聊聊吗？跟 Ami 时间有关系吗？

lines.en: : Not unless Ami has the ability to manipulate time at will and decided she didn’t want to wait any longer for Christmas. Which, you know...fair.
lines.zh: : 除非 Ami 能随心所欲地操纵时间，还决定不想再等圣诞节了。不过嘛……也挺合理。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo21
: I’ll say. Christmas is fun enough on its own, but pairing it with our yearly beach trip? I ain’t had this much fun since the first Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 可不是嘛。圣诞节本身就够好玩了，再配上我们一年一度的海滩旅行？我自从第一次宿舍大战之后就没这么开心过了。

lines.en: : Did you not enjoy the second one?
lines.zh: : 第二次你玩得不开心吗？

lines.en: : No, I had fun. And this'll probably sound a little ironic, but...it was just kind of exhausting not being able to act like myself the full time, you know?
lines.zh: : 不，我玩得挺开心的。说起来可能有点讽刺，但……整场都没法做真正的自己，实在有点累，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Feel like even Io had more fun than me and I’m not even sure if Io realizes that fun exists yet.
lines.zh: : 感觉连 Io 都比我玩得开心，而我甚至不确定 Io 知不知道"开心"这东西的存在。

lines.en: : Yeah, where is she by the way? I’m surprised you two aren’t together.
lines.zh: : 对了，她人呢？你们俩没在一起，我还挺意外的。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo22
: Io? She wandered off a little while ago to look for shade or somethin’ since she didn’t want to go swimming with me.
lines.zh: : Io？她不想跟我去游泳，就自己走开去找阴凉地儿之类的了。

lines.en: : That sounds about right. You sure you don’t want to go looking for her, though? I wouldn’t mind helping. It’s not like I have anything else going on.
lines.zh: : 听着确实像她。不过你确定不想去找她吗？我可以帮忙。反正我也没什么事。

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo23
: Uhh...we don’t...have to go look for her...
lines.zh: : 呃……我们……不用去找她也行……

lines.en: : If you, like...just want to hang out together...or something?
lines.zh: : 如果你……那个……只是想跟我待在一起……之类的？

lines.en: : Are you coming on to me right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在跟我搭讪吗？

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo24
: Dunno. Are you coming on me right now?
lines.zh: : 不知道。那你是想射在我身上吗？

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo25
: On to.
lines.zh: : 是"搭讪"啦。

lines.en: : Coming “on to” me...
lines.zh: : 我是说"搭讪"你……

lines.en: : That’s what I said.
lines.zh: : 我就是这么说的。

lines.en: : If you thought you heard something else, you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 如果你以为听到了别的东西，那你没听到。

lines.en: : I said “on to.”
lines.zh: : 我说的是"搭讪"。

lines.en: : Sensei, please don’t do this to me.
lines.zh: : 老师，求你别这样对我了。

lines.en: : Do you want me to cum on you, Uta?
lines.zh: : Uta，你想让我射在你身上吗？

lines.en: scene iosawsomethingtoo26
: No cumming until Christmas is over! It’s against the rules!
lines.zh: : 圣诞节结束之前不许射！这是违反规则的！

lines.en: : Uta, if there is anything I know about beach vacations, it is that that rule is going to be broken by the end of the day whether you like it or not.
lines.zh: : Uta，要说我对海滩度假有什么了解的话，那就是不管你愿不愿意，这条规则今天之内一定会被打破。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh!
lines.zh: : 才不会！

lines.en: : It is.
lines.zh: : 会的。

lines.en: : It won’t!
lines.zh: : 才不会！

lines.en: : Uta-
lines.zh: : Uta——

lines.en: : No cumming on Christmas!
lines.zh: : 圣诞节不许射！
